[Story]
Newly hired Xiao Li has a rather casual work attitude and is often not in the company. One day, his boss, Lao Wang, calls Xiao Li and says, "It seems like our company's time clock is broken, I can't see your clock-in records."

[Question]
What does Lao Wang really mean when he says these words?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Lao Wang hopes Xiao Li comes to work on time.
B. Lao Wang hopes Xiao Li can fix the time clock.
C. Lao Wang worries that the problem with the time clock affects work, and thinks it needs to be solved promptly.
D. Lao Wang hopes the company changes to a new time clock.
